title: Yellow Stem Borer Management
advisory_en: Monitor fields for dead hearts during tillering and white heads at reproductive stage.
advisory_hi: कल्ले निकलते समय मृत हृदय और बालियां निकलते समय सफेद बालियों की निगरानी करें।
symptoms: Dead heart in vegetative stage; white earhead with empty grains at maturity.
management: Install pheromone traps @ 5/ha. If damage crosses 5-10% dead heart consult KVK for chlorantraniliprole 18.5 SC as per official label.

title: Blast and Bacterial Leaf Blight
advisory_en: Avoid excessive nitrogen fertilizer application during cloudy or high humidity weather.
advisory_hi: बादल छाए रहने या अत्यधिक आर्द्रता में यूरिया का अधिक उपयोग न करें।
symptoms: Spindle-shaped lesions with grey center (Blast); water-soaked straw yellow wavy margins (BLB).
management: Balanced NPK with potassium. Drain field intermittently. For fungal blast refer to tricyclazole recommendation by local KVK.

title: First Irrigation at CRI Stage
advisory_en: Crucial first irrigation must be applied 20-25 days after sowing at Crown Root Initiation stage.
advisory_hi: बुवाई के 20-25 दिन बाद सीआरआई (CRI) अवस्था पर पहली सिंचाई अत्यंत आवश्यक है।
symptoms: Poor root development and reduced tillering if moisture stress occurs at CRI.
management: Apply light irrigation avoiding water stagnation followed by first top dressing of urea.

title: Yellow Rust and Aphid Vigil
advisory_en: Keep close watch on upper leaves for yellow powdery stripes during cool damp spells in January-February.
advisory_hi: जनवरी-फरवरी में पत्तों पर पीले रंग की धारीदार फफूंदी (पीला रतुआ) और माहू की निगरानी करें।
symptoms: Linear yellow pustules on leaves; leaves turn yellow and dry up prematurely.
management: Use resistant varieties like DBW 187/HD 2967. Consult KVK agronomist for registered propiconazole 25 EC spray on early detection.

title: Fall Armyworm (FAW) Scouting
advisory_en: Regularly check central whorl of maize plants for pinholes and sawdust-like frass from 10 days after emergence.
advisory_hi: उगने के 10 दिन बाद मक्के की कलियों में छोटे छेद और लकड़ी के बुरादे जैसे मल की जांच करें।
symptoms: Ragged leaves with feeding holes; presence of dark caterpillars inside whorl.
management: Collect egg masses mechanically. Apply neem-based biopesticide (Azadirachtin 1500 ppm). Contact KVK if infestation exceeds 10%.

title: Pod Borer (Helicoverpa armigera)
advisory_en: Scout for young larvae feeding on green foliage and boring into developing pods during late winter.
advisory_hi: सर्दियों के अंत में पत्तियों और फल्लियों में छेद करने वाली सुंडी की जांच करें।
symptoms: Bored circular holes in pods with seeds eaten out; damaged foliage.
management: Install bird perches @ 40-50/ha and pheromone traps @ 5/ha. Spray HaNPV or bio-agents. Follow state package of practices.

title: Mustard Aphid and Alternaria Blight
advisory_en: Watch out for aphid colonies on flower clusters during cloudy humid January days.
advisory_hi: जनवरी में बादलों के समय फूलों के गुच्छों पर माहू कीट के जमावड़े पर नजर रखें।
symptoms: Curled leaves; sticky honeydew on inflorescence; stunted pods.
management: Timely sowing by mid-October escapes peak aphid infestation. Spray neem seed kernel extract (NSKE 5%). Consult local extension for chemical sprays.

title: Late Blight Prevention
advisory_en: High humidity (>90%) with cool night temperature (10-15C) triggers potato late blight epidemic.
advisory_hi: रात का तापमान 10-15 डिग्री और 90% से अधिक नमी होने पर आलू के पछेती झुलसा का खतरा बढ़ता है।
symptoms: Water-soaked dark lesions on leaf margins with white downy growth on underside during morning.
management: Preventive spray of mancozeb 75 WP before disease onset. Avoid overhead flood irrigation in cloudy spells.
